items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: Shulvret Farrar went with Shulper so I got acquainted with the guys

ctx.x: MR. CHALLIS: Charlie Margose. Shulvret Farrar went with Shulper so I got acquainted with the guys, you know, and kidded around and Jimmy and I became, we were roommates. We went out and Jimmy, you know, was very fine for me to have him in my corner. I -- he's the guy I think that got me in the band and when we roomed together, why we went around to these different towns and he knew everybody there, he had been around and played all around, and he took me around, you know, to some of these places, meet a lot of…
